implementation.fieldAndRoleProof: The source profile is restricted to the witnessed AC1024 Model and Layout1 records, their complete two-entry ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary, validated type-82 source frames, reciprocal block-record links, single-entry extension dictionaries and ADSK_XREC_LAYOUTTHUMBNAIL records. The OBJECTS inspector checks the NOD root-key role, complete layout dictionary, each complete LAYOUT PlotSettings/Layout field set, mapped owner/reactor/XDICTIONARY references, exact EED values, complete extension dictionaries and typed XRECORD payloads against the existing bounded immutable XRECORD source snapshot. DXF does not encode the DWG viewport count/list fields directly; each source list member is instead required to have a unique emitted VIEWPORT identity owned by the mapped paper-space BLOCK_RECORD. Last-active VPORT/VIEWPORT targets are checked by emitted record type and mapped handle.
